properties.name: Four small fixes from the bhome field report, none of which needed a design decision
properties.rationale:
Grouped as one change because they share a justification rather than a mechanism: each is a case where reflow2 already had the right answer available and was not using it, and none required Anthony to settle anything.

⭐ (1) IS A BIGGER FACT THAN THE FINDINGS IT WAS ATTACHED TO. bhome's words: eight isolated nodes against two clusters of two, "buried mid-sentence inside a prose message, repeated identically on both cluster findings... it is precisely the 'what could this not see' information the rest of the reply is so good at surfacing structurally." As prose it was also ABSENT ENTIRELY when the rule found no clusters — the case where it matters most. Implemented as a shared `isolated_in_walk()` on the network rather than a second computation, because `rule_populations` already records why: deriving a number the rule also computes "would create a second implementation of one number, able to disagree with the first".

⭐ (4) REMOVES THREE OF SIX FINDINGS AT THE SOURCE, and uses a mechanism that already exists. `ruling: parks` and `swept.parked` were built precisely so "a count that grows when somebody does the right thing" stops teaching people to stop reading it. Nobody had pointed them at reflow2's OWN scaffolding, so following the documented workflow reliably produced `orphan_node` findings for Questions that `gap_to_prompt` had just created and for `epoch:genesis`. The nodes stay VISIBLE and counted in `swept.parked` — parked is not silenced.

📌 WHAT THIS TRANCHE DELIBERATELY EXCLUDES, so the omission is not read as neglect: the cross-type duplicate repair, inline golden-thread links, the corroboration relation, and append-mode for long fields. Every one of those is an OPEN decision, and settling one by building it would forge the owner's word — which `rule:design-intent-moves-only-on-the-owners-word` forbids and which this project has reverted itself for before.

⚠️ WHAT THE BLAST RADIUS COULD NOT ESTABLISH, per the impact-check discipline: propagation stops at depth 5 with 38 nodes beyond it, it cannot see coupling nobody recorded, and a file no Artifact points at is invisible to it — 141 files are in that state. `coverage_report` is what distinguishes "nothing downstream" from "nothing modelled downstream".
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: The four items in bhome's 2026-08-31 report that were unambiguous — no open question, no vocabulary change, no reversal of anything settled. (1) The count of nodes sitting ALONE in the topology walk becomes `swept.isolated_in_walk` instead of a clause buried mid-sentence in every unthreaded_cluster message. (2) `constrains` stops stamping `basis` when no `contribution` was given, because there is no estimate involved in "these two streams must never connect". (3) The brainstorm skill names `EVOLVES_INTO` in step 5 as the way to record what an idea became. (4) `gap_to_prompt` and `genesis` park the nodes they create, so following the documented workflow stops manufacturing orphan findings.
